name: saveit.now
title_zh: 69 个技能打包上架，拆开是散件、合上是工具箱
tagline_zh: 不用逐个翻 GitHub 找技能了。一套装齐 69 个现成 Agent 能力，装完即用；挑着装也行，按需拆包。
tagline_en: Stop hunting GitHub for skills one by one. 69 ready-made Agent abilities in one install; pick what you need, skip.
why_zh: 它把零散技能收进统一目录，装一个等于逛完 69 个仓库。省的是你挨个看 README、试兼容性的时间。
why_en: It folds 69 scattered repos into one navigable pack. One install, one entry point — saves you the tour of 69 READMEs and.
limit_zh: 合集不保证每个技能都适配你的 Agent 运行时；装完需自行逐项试跑。部分技能依赖外部 API 或本地环境。
limit_en: Not every skill may fit your Agent runtime; test individually after install. Some need external APIs or local setup — errors won't come with support.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 69 skills in one pack: loose parts, or a toolbox
